findings.message: listarTarefasEquipe filters (responsavelId, prioridade, status, prazoDe, prazoAte) had no state. Added filtroResponsavelId, filtroPrioridade, filtroStatus, filtroPrazoDe and filtroPrazoAte with public setters that publish and reload the list from the first page.

Entry param listaTarefasId (effect select:tarefasEquipe) has no state with source entry.params.listaTarefasId. Added state listaTarefasId (URL-only) as the list filter (listaId) with setter setListaTarefasId.

Command trocarResponsavelTarefa has no <command>.input state. Added trocarResponsavelTarefaDraft (only responsavelId, prefilled from entry param responsavelId) with setTrocarResponsavelTarefaDraft; id and version come from the open tarefa.
selectedTarefa has no selection method. Added selectTarefa(id | null), which publishes the id (mirrored in the URL), clears the draft and loads the record into tarefa through obterTarefaEquipe.

After trocarResponsavelTarefa or cancelarTarefaEquipe the output has no contagemPorSituacao, so the board column totals stay stale until the list is reloaded; the row in tarefas is updated (venceHoje/atrasada kept from the row, false when no longer open) or removed when it no longer matches the status or responsible filter. A row not in the loaded page is not inserted.
The list is paged but no entry param records the page; listarTarefasEquipe(page, append) takes the page directly and nothing persists it.
